description: This file defines the CalendarSubscriptionService class, which manages calendar subscription operations such as subscribing, unsubscribing, processing webhooks, and handling events within a calendar integration system. It interacts with various repositories, adapters, and services to facilitate calendar event synchronization and caching.

classes.name: CalendarSubscriptionService
classes.description: A service class that manages calendar subscription lifecycle, including subscribing, unsubscribing, webhook processing, event handling, and feature toggles.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a calendar, handling credential validation, adapter invocation, and event processing.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a calendar and cleans up cache if enabled.

methods.name: processWebhook
methods.description: Handles incoming webhook requests, validates them, and processes calendar events.

methods.name: processEvents
methods.description: Fetches, processes, caches, and syncs calendar events, updating sync status and calculating propagation lag.

methods.name: calculatePropagationLag
methods.description: Calculates statistics on event propagation lag based on timestamps.

methods.name: checkForNewSubscriptions
methods.description: Periodically checks and subscribes to new calendars based on feature flags.

methods.name: isCacheEnabled
methods.description: Checks if global cache feature is enabled.

methods.name: isCacheEnabledForUser
methods.description: Checks if cache feature is enabled for a specific user.

methods.name: isSyncEnabled
methods.description: Checks if synchronization feature is enabled.

methods.name: getCredential
methods.description: Retrieves calendar credentials, including delegation if applicable.
